data.name: Haybora
data.gender_notes: Haybora is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'hayb' meaning 'mountain goat', symbolizing strength, courage, and protection. In Swahili, it is also known as 'Mbulamutu', which translates to 'he who walks on mountains'. The name Haybora carries the meaning “Mountain Goat” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haybora usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain goat and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the journey towards inner strength and resilience, overcoming challenges with grace and determination.
data.etymology: Haybora belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain Goat.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haybora total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
